"""Hand-computed pin-interaction cases (move x quota of old/new group)."""
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import harness, ref

# leaf-spine 3 leaves / 2 spines: templates 0=(0->1) fp{0,1} dom0, 3=(1->2) fp{1,2} dom1
TOPO = ['leaf-spine', 3, 2]
CAPS = [10, 10, 10, 10, 10]
GROUPS = [[1, 100], [1, 100]]
Q = {'groups': [], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}

def run(label, tasks, edits, want_v, want_acc):
    sess = {'topology': TOPO, 'caps': list(CAPS), 'groups': [list(g) for g in GROUPS],
            'tasks': [list(t) for t in tasks], 'query': Q,
            'transactions': [{'revision': 0, 'edits': [list(e) for e in edits], 'query': Q}]}
    req = {'version': 2, 'sessions': [sess]}
    got, p = harness.run_request(req)
    out = got['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0]
    r = ref.Ref(sess)
    refout = r.transact(sess['transactions'][0])
    ok = (out['violations'] == want_v and out['accepted'] == want_acc
          and refout['violations'] == want_v and refout['accepted'] == want_acc)
    print(('ok   ' if ok else 'FAIL ') + '%-52s got=%s ref=%s want=%s' % (label, out['violations'], refout['violations'], want_v))
    return 0 if ok else 1

# t0 pinned in g0 (tpl0 dom0), t1 pinned in g1 (tpl3 dom1)
T2 = [[0, 0, 1, 7, 1], [3, 1, 1, 7, 1]]
# t0 and t2 pinned in g0, t1 pinned in g1
T3 = [[0, 0, 1, 7, 1], [3, 1, 1, 7, 1], [1, 0, 1, 7, 1]]

fails = 0
fails += run('move pinned into g1 + quota g1 (new group)', T2,
             [['move', 0, 1], ['quota', 1, 5]], [0, 1, 0, 2], False)
fails += run('move pinned out of g0 + quota g0 (old group)', T2,
             [['move', 0, 1], ['quota', 0, 5]], [0, 1, 0, 1], False)
fails += run('two pinned in g0, one moves, quota g0', T3,
             [['move', 0, 1], ['quota', 0, 5]], [0, 1, 0, 2], False)
fails += run('two pinned in g0, one moves, quota both', T3,
             [['move', 0, 1], ['quota', 0, 5], ['quota', 1, 5]], [0, 1, 0, 3], False)
fails += run('quota both groups, no moves', T3,
             [['quota', 0, 5], ['quota', 1, 5]], [0, 0, 0, 3], False)
fails += run('move pinned, no quota change', T3,
             [['move', 0, 1]], [0, 1, 0, 1], False)
fails += run('unpinned move + quota of its group', [[0, 0, 1, 7, 0], [3, 1, 1, 7, 1]],
             [['move', 0, 1], ['quota', 0, 5]], [0, 1, 0, 0], False)
fails += run('pin then move in same tx (new pin unprotected)', [[0, 0, 1, 7, 0], [3, 1, 1, 7, 0]],
             [['pin', 0, 1], ['move', 0, 1], ['quota', 0, 5]], [0, 1, 0, 0], False)
fails += run('legal: weight within budget, no pins', [[0, 0, 1, 7, 0]],
             [['weight', 0, 50]], [0, 0, 0, 0], True)
fails += run('pinned task, weight unchanged rewrite', [[0, 0, 5, 7, 1]],
             [['weight', 0, 5], ['class', 0, 7], ['pin', 0, 1]], [0, 0, 0, 0], True)
fails += run('pinned task, quota rewritten to same value', [[0, 0, 5, 7, 1]],
             [['quota', 0, 1], ['budget', 0, 100], ['cap', 0, 10]], [0, 0, 0, 0], True)
print('edge2 failures:', fails)
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
PYEOF
